subtitle: Out Manila · Qingdao Airlines charter
overview: A short charter-flight break from Manila to Changsha, then on to Zhangjiajie. See Orange Isle and Mini Venice Town in Changsha, then the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park) with Avatar Hallelujah Mountain, and cross the Grand Canyon glass bridge. Hotels are Days Hotel by Wyndham Changsha and Qingxinyuan Hotel Zhangjiajie, or similar. This is a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Oct 27–30 2026 to Jun 22–25 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Orange Isle: A long river island in the Xiang River in Changsha, with parks and gardens; the battery car is not included.
placeDesc.Mini Venice Town: A canal-style town in Changsha with waterways, boats and Italian-inspired scenery.
placeDesc.Taiping Old Street: A historic Changsha lane of old-style shops and local snack stalls.
placeDesc.Huangxing Road: Changsha's busy downtown pedestrian shopping street.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie with a long cable car, glass skywalk and the Tianmen Cave, offered as an optional tour.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie Avatar scenic area: A famous park of tall sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains in the movie Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Elevator: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the park.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge between two cliffs inside the scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The sandstone pillar in the park that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in Avatar.
placeDesc.Breath-taking Platform: A viewpoint in the park offering sweeping views of the sandstone pillars.
placeDesc.West Sea Clouds: A scenic viewpoint in the Zhangjiajie area known for sea-of-clouds views among the peaks.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass bridge over a deep canyon in the Zhangjiajie region.
